human_authorisation.authorisation_note: User explicitly asked to activate the next candidate registry, continuing the chain after S-REG-30 (sport_metric extension + threshold_marker). Research identified exercise_token_registry_3b (S-REG-06) as the safest next target - its dependencies (activity_registry_1, movement_registry_3) are already legacy-active via S-REG-04's bridge, and no generic guard blocks it (unlike exercise_activity_applicability_registry, which s_v1_23's stricter guard unconditionally blocks). Cross-checking every record's movement_id against the live movement registry surfaced a genuine dangling FK: candidate record 'front_plank_token' references movement_id 'brace', which does not exist in the live 4-entry active movement registry. Shown this finding and three options (activate the 3 valid records only, activate all 4 including the dangling one, or hold the domain entirely), the user chose to activate only the 3 records with verified-valid movement_id and activity_ids references, excluding the dangling one by explicit decision.
